name: Binned Raster Traversal
definition: A rasterization traversal method where each tile's CUDA block linearly scans a contiguous interval of the pair stream. The interval is the concatenation of K coarse bins in front-to-back order, allowing a plain linear scan without per-bin branching.
summary: Binned Raster Traversal is a GPU-accelerated Gaussian splatting method that replaces global depth sorting with tile-local binning, explicitly managing tile-primitive mapping on the CPU and staging parameters in shared memory for cooperative compositing.
